cover_letter:
Dear Cardo Hotels Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Marketing Intern position at Cardo Hotels. Your vision for building the next generation hospitality brand, focused on experiential places and a compelling brand story, immediately captured my attention. As a junior digital marketer with practical experience in content and web development, I am keen to contribute to a brand that values creativity, self-reflection, and cultural programming.

My background as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto has provided me with direct experience in creating engaging digital content and managing web presence. I own on-page SEO strategies, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain client websites using WordPress. These skills directly align with the Principal Accountabilities of this internship, particularly in creating engaging content for social media, websites, and newsletters, and assisting in the development of marketing campaigns.

Furthermore, my personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my proactive approach and creative capabilities. I independently designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented social media integration, and applied advanced SEO techniques. This experience underscores my familiarity with social media platforms and my ability to manage digital content, reflecting my strong interest in digital media and brand visibility.

I am proficient in tracking site performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, which would support analyzing marketing campaign data for optimization. My professional fluency in English, combined with good communication and organizational skills, ensures I am prepared to collaborate effectively within your team. I am eager to gain hands-on experience within Cardo Hotels and apply my foundational digital marketing skills to support your unique brand journey.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to grow my expertise with your team and contribute to Cardo Hotels’ innovative approach to hospitality.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
